housing: Long Beach renters mostly live in small and mid-size apartment buildings, many built before 1980, along with duplexes and bungalows.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Foundation of Los Angeles, Long Beach office

climate: Salt air near the coast causes rust and mold, so check window frames, railings and bathrooms; many older buildings have no air conditioning, so ask before you sign.
fact: Long Beach adopted its rental inspection program in 2015, and renters can ask a landlord whether the building is in good standing with it.
